Agent Name: BusinessLogic_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: Misapplied the business logic by counting even-numbered street addresses (fronts facing west) for the sunset design without accounting that all awnings are installed on the back of the houses. Since the back faces the opposite direction of the front, clients with odd-numbered addresses (fronts facing east, backs facing west) should receive the sunset design. Consequently, directing the analysis to count even numbers led to the wrong result.
